focus-ring-parchment.note: focus ring (double on leather: dark outline + light focus; single on parchment); 160x40 element centered with an 8 px margin

window-frame.note: opaque leather with baked-in title bar (40 px) and status bar (28 px), bronze trim and 4 rivets; the center is tiled leather (no visible seams when stretched)

divider-thread-medallion.note: horizontal 3-slice: left thread (stretchable, x 0-326), fixed medallion (central 44 px), right thread (stretchable); in Avalonia, better to use 2 tiled threads + divider-medallion.png centered

stitch-h-tile.note: repeatable tile (10 px period: 6 thread + 4 gap), color #8A6C4A

stitch-v-tile.note: repeatable tile (10 px period: 6 thread + 4 gap), color #8A6C4A

tab-parchment.note: active sidebar tab: flush with the left edge (x=10 of the PNG = window edge); 5 px wax-red mark on the left
